items.detail: 其余行：期望 ['8', '17', '23', '42', '56', '99']，实际 ['', 'input_path = Path("/app/input.txt")', 'output_path = Path("/app/output.txt")', '', 'lines = input_path.read_text().splitlines()', 'numbers = [int(line.strip()) for line in lines if line.strip()]', '', 'total = sum(numbers)', 'count = len(numbers)', 'sorted_numbers = sorted(numbers)', '', 'with output_path.open("w") as f:', '    f.write(f"{total}\\n")', '    f.write(f"{count}\\n")', '    for number in sorted_numbers:', '        f.write(f"{number}\\n")', '```']
